notes.title: Update v0.2.2
notes.notes: Added a new map (Facility), a dark and close-quarters map lit up with NVGs, in a free-for-all Deathmatch hellscape.

notes.title: Road To Release
notes.notes:
Good afternoon guys, gals, and non-binary pals!

Today's the first day of July, and so it's time for our monthly Road To Release update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/e7041eb1807272a3e85c283d109a0b13eb5ce6e7.png[/img]

First off, we'd like to finally introduce the first official Project Polygun map! Say hello to: Bootcamp - a small dual-military-outpost featuring fantastic rock formations and a crashed cargo jet in the center for opposing teams to duke it out across.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/6a7ed94051de833b7d020b7e08610f0dcc1d1b7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/8f49b78cecc76442236202cc55665c1c7f118aa6.png[/img]

Secondly, we've added in some nifty new particle effects. Specifically, ones for the smoke grenade and the frag grenade. Now you can blow up your enemies in adorable polygonal style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/5b0f38c8aa1a0f88b39e7bd1658e640594244550.png[/img]

The last semi-major thing is the lighting change. Very bloom! Much sunrays! Many lensflares!

Oh, and we finally got rid of those horrid robot first-person arms. There are still some issues with the way the model is being displayed, but at least the style is consistent with the theme. We might have to hire a new hand model, though.

notes.title: Upcoming Release!
notes.notes:
Hey gamers, it's official! We've brought things to a solid point and now we're looking forward to our upcoming release. This is the official launch announcement of Project Polygun!!

[b]We're planning to release on November 2nd, 2020.[/b]

Over the next few months, we're going to focus heavily on final polishing and bug fixes in order to get our game to a solid releasable state (as well as to focus on a ton of marketing in the meantime). Also, after all this time, we've FINALLY gotten source control set up. For the non-nerds: that means we now have a solid working environment for our team to collaborate on the game's code and files with ease, helping to expedite the development process and make things a helluvalot easier to do.

We're looking forward to November, and can't wait to see you all on the battlefields!

Much love,
The Arkadia Galactic Team
